8.4.2 Enabling/Disabling wakeup notification
[SWS_Can_00445] ⌈Can driver shall use the following APIs provided by Icu driver, to
enable and disable the wakeup event notification:
• Icu_EnableNotification
• Icu_DisableNotification
⌋
[SWS_Can_00446] ⌈Icu_EnableNotification shall be called when ”external”
Can controllers have been transitioned to SLEEP state.⌋
[SWS_Can_00447] ⌈Icu_DisableNotification shall be called when ”external”
Can controllers have been transitioned to STOPPED state.⌋
